description: C5 — L4 DECIDE → L6 OBSERVE trace-ID envelope, v0.1 (prep draft, NOT frozen). One trace ID born at L1 ingress, carried through every hop, on every log line and in the hash-chained event envelope. Per-stage latency attribution answers 'which stage ate the budget' in one lookup. Owned by the consumer: L6 OBSERVE (Ledger lane).

body.description: The decision_made body. The keys disposition/budget_outcome/lock_evaluation/freshness/threshold_counterfactual/links are the frozen Type-1 vocabulary (eventlog.py _BODY_REQUIRED); C5 ADDS policy_version and stage_latencies — an additive widening that ships with the contract-amendment ADR (see README open items).

corroboration.description: ADR-019/D5 leg verdict; null unless a suppress verdict reached the leg.

as_of.description: When the freshness legs were evaluated.

input_sha256.description: Canonical input hash; the flip-audit and raw-payload join key. The raw bytes themselves NEVER cross — they are keyed by this hash (event-log-audit P8).

jev_model.description: Pinned Jev model version; null on deterministic pre-Jev paths.

links.description: Join keys: input_sha256, decision_requested seq ref, episode links, model_drift links.

lock_evaluation.description: The corroboration/leg verdict dict (race_payloads.lock_evaluation). Opaque to this contract; must be an object.

policy_version.description: REQUIRED (new in C5). The policy version that decided — fills the gap the Prism UI currently labels as honestly absent (prism-ui.md P2/A6, INV-3). Opaque string (semver or content hash); resolution of canonical PolicyVersion.content is Aditya's Type-1 Q3 — this contract carries the version label, not the content.

stage_latencies.description: Per-stage latency attribution in milliseconds, measured on a monotonic clock at each stage boundary. Answers 'which stage ate the budget' in one lookup. forward_ms is NOT here — it arrives later via C6's ForwardReceipt and L6 reconciles it onto the READ view; the sealed decision_made row is never rewritten.

correlate_ms.description: L3 DECIDE-1 leg (fingerprint, dedup, episodes, storm).

decide_ms.description: L4 total decide leg (policy kernel + race + fail-open ladder). >= gate_race_ms.

gate_race_ms.description: L4 Jev race budget leg (the timed race window).

normalize_ms.description: L2 NORMALIZE leg (vendor payload → canonical Alert).

threshold_counterfactual.description: ADR-023/D9 counterfactual receipt — set ONLY on the live suppress path; null on page/passthrough rather than pretending every decision needs contrast.

contract.description: Contract identity. The YAML/JSON carries its own version so a reader never has to guess which contract a payload was written against.

envelope.description: Hash-chained event envelope. row_hash = sha256(canonical(envelope-without-hashes + body) || prev_hash); the envelope IS part of the hashed material, so trace_id tampering breaks the chain. trace_id lives here ONCE — it is never duplicated into the body (SSOT).

event_id.description: Per-row random id (uuid4 hex). NOT a correlation id — correlation is trace_id.

outbox_id.description: NULL on suppress (no outbox row); the outbox row id otherwise.

segment_id.description: OPTIONAL in v0.1. Names the chain segment when the log has rolled (chain-of-segments); absent on the first segment.

trace_id.description: W3C Trace Context trace-id: 16 random bytes, 32 lowercase hex, all-zeros forbidden. Minted at L1 ingress (or continued from a valid inbound traceparent). One trace_id per inbound request; carried through L2→L3→L4→L5→L6 on every hop and every log line.

title: DecisionRecord
